title: t3cp/release/1: one fork release's post, dist/data/v1/releases/<tag>.json, written by site/build/release-build.mjs from news/posts/<tag>.json
description: A fork release measured against its upstream base nightly and its previous fork release. Exactly one of checker.written_in_session and checker.prompt_sha256 is present (release-post.mjs enforces it). The build re-runs the checker on the committed text (news/posts/<tag>.json) against the bundle rebuilt from data. charts_only true: no written sentence; post.summary holds rendered claims only (or null) and post.sections are the eight headline charts with their machine captions; charts_only_reason says why (checker_failed: the written text failed twice; stale: the text that passed no longer passes against the measured record; no_text_yet: no text has passed yet; pending: a fork, base or previous record is not complete, so the post shows tag, date, changelog and charts with no claim, counts {} and deltas []; no_base: the base was measured in another era of the benchmark and no verdict crosses an era boundary, so the post has the same form as pending, titled <tag>: no comparable base; over_budget: the full release file was over its byte budget, so it is charts only with the headline rows, and the build warns). Every delta carries saturated (which records could not serve every agent at its level); at a saturated level only turns_completed and agents_served keep a verdict, every other metric has note saturated. Chart ids: fork-vs-base.<metric>.ladder.<platform> (fork and base against agents, every level), series.<metric>.<platform> (the metric by nightly with this release marked, at the page's agents level), fork-vs-prev.<metric>.<platform> (each fork release in turn, this one against the previous).

synthetic.description: Present only on development output from synthetic data; release-post.mjs refuses to write it under data/.

levels.description: The agent levels the counts and deltas cover (the overview's 1 | 50 | 100 | 250 switch).

counts.description: Per agent level: verdicts of the platform's eight headline metrics against the base nightly. A record-level headline metric (scope once) counts at every level.

deltas.description: The rows the release page renders: the headline metrics at every level, every other row beyond noise against the base at its own level, and agents_served at a level where the fork or its base is saturated (the page's saturated line quotes it). The whole table is in the records; the comparison with the previous release is in the series files. prev, delta_vs_prev_pct, verdict_vs_prev, note_vs_prev, saturated.prev, text.prev, text.threshold_pct and text.delta_vs_prev_pct are no longer written and stay valid when present. delta_pct = (fork - base) / base in percent with its real sign; the verdict already applies the metric's direction. text holds the display strings the post's prose copies.

title.description: Always the template: <tag>: <a> regressed, <b> improved, <c> within noise (vs <base tag>), counts at headline_level.

summary.description: The rendered summary (placeholders filled with their clauses). charts_only: the largest headline claims at the headline level, rendered, or null when none moved.

quotes.description: Whole lines of the public changelog the text chose, each once: render them in one 'From the changelog' block at the end of the post, never by a chart or a claim. Empty for charts-only and pending.

changelog.description: The release's lines from the fork's public changelog (CHANGELOG-public.md), verbatim; empty until it is published.

written_in_session.description: The text was written by hand from the bundle and checked by news/check.mjs (the launch path).

prompt_sha256.description: The text came from the model with this prompt file (the later CI path).

attempts.description: Attempts recorded for the deciding bundle; 0 when no text was written.

findings.description: Always empty: a release never carries findings (the footer gives their number). A finding is recorded only in news/posts/<tag>.json, without the refused text.

bundle_sha256.description: sha256 of the post bundle the text was checked against; release-bundle.mjs rebuilds it from data/.

sha.description: base only: the merge-base SHA the base record was built from; null before that record exists

sha7.description: base only: the first seven characters of sha, for 'upstream base, built from source at <sha7>'
